symptom: DM4310 on CAN2 never answered: g_dm_can2_init_result=0, g_dm_can2_tx_count=0, RCC_APB1ENR.CAN2EN=0, g_dm_can2_feedback_valid=0

root_cause.why: With VEHICLE_EXTENSION_HOME_ONLY=1 this .inc replaces the real Holding() in the #else branch of startup_axes.c. Holding() therefore always returned 0, so every DM_CAN2_ModuleService() call site (main.c 3213/3227/3233/3272) was skipped. DM_CAN2_Service only calls DM_CAN2_Init() inside the read_request branch, so CAN2 was never clocked and the 4310 could never be reached.
root_cause.verification: fromelf disassembly: StartupAxes_Holding = MOVS r0,#0 / BX lr (constant 0). RCC_APB1ENR bit26 = 0 after boot. No DM frame ever transmitted (tx_count stayed 0).

secondary_fixes_same_session: safety.c: wheel CAN guard is not armed while the chassis is not driving and a mechanism axis owns the VM (mechanism CAN traffic starved the 400ms wheel poll and latched SAFETY_FAULT_CAN_DATA 0x20, which cascaded into StartupAxes FAULT state=5)
lift_ruler_adapter.c: LiftRuler_Service healthy argument no longer uses g_can_guard_ready (mechanism axes do not drive the wheels)

main.c: removed !VEHICLE_EXTENSION_HOME_ONLY gating from DM_CAN2_ModuleService / VehicleArm_Service / App_CombinedTestStep service calls (that gating disabled them in exactly the profile that builds the extension hold)
can.c: CAN1_SINGLE_REPLY_WAIT_MS 30 -> 60 (node4 answers in ~17ms vs 6-8ms for 1/2/3)

after_fix.note_zero_sample: one sample read 0 because a new read_request clears feedback_valid before the 7-parameter cycle completes; read timing artefact, not motion
